sections.heading: R-Rated 'X-Files' Director's Cut
paragraphs: Entertainment Weekly reports that 'The X-Files: I Want to Believe' has been given an R-rated director's cut, making the film scarier. A new trailer has been released in anticipation of the movie's streaming debut.

sections.heading: UK Buzz
paragraphs: Gizmodo describes the new trailer for 'The X-Files: I Want to Believe – Vrach Frankenshteyn' as perfectly creepy, indicating a strong UK interest in the film.

sections.heading: Streaming Release and Reboot
paragraphs: MovieWeb notes that the debut of the R-rated cut's trailer comes ahead of a new reboot of 'The X-Files', adding to the excitement around the franchise.
